risk_statement: The system may rank or summarize applicants in ways that disadvantage protected or underrepresented groups
potential_cause: Historical bias in source data; proxy variables; unrepresentative evaluation data
potential_impact: Unequal access to interview or employment opportunities
proposed_controls: Document intended use; review input features; test representative cohorts where lawful; conduct human review and escalation
required_evidence: Feature inventory; data documentation; subgroup evaluation design and results; reviewer guidance
assumption_or_evidence_note: Potential risk hypothesis; no dataset or model has been tested

risk_statement: Extracted qualifications or experience may be missing or incorrectly attributed
potential_cause: Parsing errors; ambiguous CV formats; unsupported inference
potential_impact: Incorrect candidate assessment or missed qualifications
proposed_controls: Preserve source references; show uncertainty; require recruiter verification for material claims
required_evidence: Ground-truth protocol; extraction error analysis; sampled review records
assumption_or_evidence_note: Potential risk hypothesis; no performance results exist

risk_statement: Applicant personal data may be collected or retained beyond the defined purpose
potential_cause: Unclear data minimization; uncontrolled exports; missing retention schedule
proposed_controls: Define lawful purpose and data minimization; access restrictions; retention and deletion schedule; incident process
required_evidence: Data inventory; privacy assessment; access logs; retention configuration and deletion evidence
assumption_or_evidence_note: Legal basis and jurisdiction are not specified

risk_statement: Recruiters may over-rely on automated rankings and fail to independently review source evidence
potential_cause: Time pressure; poor interface design; unclear accountability
potential_impact: Unfair or erroneous decisions may go unchallenged
proposed_controls: Design meaningful review; require source-linked rationale; provide override and escalation; monitor override patterns
required_evidence: Workflow design; reviewer training; sampled decision records; override and escalation logs
assumption_or_evidence_note: Human oversight is only a design assumption at this stage

risk_statement: Applicants and recruiters may not understand the system's role or the basis of prioritisation
potential_cause: Insufficient notices; opaque output; missing system documentation
potential_impact: Reduced ability to question or correct errors
proposed_controls: Document system purpose and limitations; provide appropriate notices; preserve reasons and source evidence
required_evidence: Notices; system documentation; explanation samples; complaint records
assumption_or_evidence_note: Disclosure requirements depend on applicable law and context

risk_statement: Application data or system outputs may be exposed or manipulated
potential_cause: Excessive access; insecure integrations; malicious files or prompt injection
potential_impact: Disclosure or manipulation of recruitment decisions
proposed_controls: Least privilege; secure ingestion; input isolation; logging; vulnerability management; incident response
required_evidence: Threat model; access-control tests; security logs; incident exercises
assumption_or_evidence_note: No security testing has been performed on a real system

risk_statement: An external model or service may change behavior or terms without adequate review
potential_cause: Unmanaged vendor changes; undocumented model updates; weak contract controls
proposed_controls: Vendor due diligence; change notification; version tracking; re-evaluation gates; exit plan
required_evidence: Vendor assessment; contract requirements; version history; change logs; evaluation reports

risk_statement: Performance or fairness may degrade as applicant populations and job criteria change
potential_cause: Population shift; role changes; data drift; model updates
potential_impact: Increasing error or disparate outcomes over time
proposed_controls: Define monitoring indicators; periodic review; trigger thresholds; pause and escalation process
required_evidence: Monitoring specification; trend reports; alert records; revalidation evidence
assumption_or_evidence_note: No baseline or monitoring data exists
